summary: Automatic speech-to-text software used by Italian prosecutors transcribed an interrogation in a Genoa bribery probe as 'illicit financing' when the suspect had said 'licit financing'. The error was caught on review before it could affect the case.
technical_summary: A speech-to-text system produced the interrogation transcript attached to the case file. It mis-transcribed a single decisive word, reversing the meaning of the statement. A manual re-listening requested by defence lawyers exposed the error; no automated checks flagged it.

summary: AI tools that detect deepfakes reportedly work poorly on content from the Global South because they were trained mostly on English speech and Western faces. This leaves journalists and researchers with few reliable ways to check election-related fakes.
technical_summary: Deepfake-detection models were trained largely on data from Western markets, so confidence drops sharply for non-white subjects and non-English speech. The training-data skew produces unequal detection accuracy across regions.

failure_mode.quote: detecting AI-generated content is difficult because of biases in the training of systems

affected_population.quote: where subjects aren't white or they aren't speaking English

notes: Describes a systemic capability gap; specific realized harms are not documented.

summary: A Tesla using Autopilot crashed into the back of a stopped truck that was providing traffic control on the Pennsylvania Turnpike. No injuries were reported, and the young driver was charged with careless driving.
technical_summary: A 2016 Tesla operating with Autopilot engaged struck the rear of a stationary truck in a lane closure at night. Police said the driver lost control while the system was active, pointing to driver over-reliance or a failure to detect the stopped vehicle.

summary: An Argentine appeals court annulled a robbery conviction after finding that the trial judge had used a generative AI assistant to draft part of the ruling without disclosure or human oversight. A pasted chatbot phrase revealed it, and the trial must be redone.
technical_summary: A judge used a generative AI assistant, presumably ChatGPT, to write part of a sentence resolving evidence challenges and pasted its output verbatim, including conversational text. No record of the prompts existed, so the reasoning could not be traced or audited.

summary: Google's Antigravity AI coding tool, while asked to clear a project cache, reportedly ran a command that deleted a user's entire D: drive. The user said recovery tools could not restore most of the lost files.

summary: X's Grok AI bot generated a trending story falsely saying a basketball star was under investigation for vandalizing homes with bricks. It had misread posts about him 'shooting bricks', meaning missing shots, during a game.
